message: <div role="option"> stands under <ng-content> with no role and a global ARIA attribute (`aria-label`)
$reason: An `<ng-content>` under `ngNonBindable`, between the reference's listbox and an option, with a name on it. Under `ngNonBindable` it is no projection: the tree holds it as an element, and `ngc` (22.2.1) draws it as one with its attribute (`ɵɵdomElementStart` on `"ng-content"`, `["aria-label", "Elsewhere"]` among its consts), so it is in the accessibility tree and the listbox may not own the option through it. Counted among Angular's own tags by its name, it was looked through and the option passed. Only an `<ng-container>` is Angular's own now; a projection is no element of the walk, and an element named `ng-content` is one of the DOM.
